questions.question: Dr Rachid must train young dentists in CAD/CAM. What is the first advice he should give them?
options: CAD/CAM is a simple technical tool
CAD/CAM is a revolution that requires mastery of the digital workflow
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'CAD/CAM is a digital revolution that requires complete mastery of the digital workflow, from impression to cementation.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must create a CAD/CAM training center. What is the main objective?
options: Train practitioners mastering the digital workflow
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'The main objective is to train practitioners to master the digital workflow to improve the quality of care.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid must evaluate the effectiveness of a digital workflow. Which measure is the most important?
options: The quality of restorations and patient satisfaction
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'The quality of restorations and patient satisfaction are the most important measures for evaluating the effectiveness of a digital workflow.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must manage a crisis: a patient had an allergic reaction to a printed surgical guide. What is the priority?
options: Identify the cause of the allergy
Protect the patient and treat the allergy
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'The priority is to protect the patient and treat the allergy before any other action.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid must train residents in risk management in CAD/CAM. What is the fundamental principle?
options: Risk management is a legal obligation
Risk management is an ethical responsibility towards patients
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'Risk management is a fundamental ethical responsibility towards patients.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must create a good practice guide for CAD/CAM. What is the main reference?
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'Good practices must be based on updated scientific data.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid must train young dentists in communication about CAD/CAM. What is the key message?
options: CAD/CAM allows more precise and faster care
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'CAD/CAM allows more precise and faster care, improving the patient experience.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must create a research program in CAD/CAM. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'Research in CAD/CAM aims to improve clinical practices and the quality of care.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid must manage a reference practice in CAD/CAM. What is the pillar of excellence?
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'Excellence is based on continuing education and patient safety.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must evaluate the impact of CAD/CAM on public health. What is the role of CAD/CAM?
options: It is an essential tool for the precision of care
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'CAD/CAM is an essential tool for the precision of care and the improvement of patients' quality of life.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid must train residents in innovation in CAD/CAM. Which current trend is important?
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'Innovation in CAD/CAM concerns machines, AI and new materials.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must create a skills assessment system in CAD/CAM. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'Skills assessment aims to improve the quality of care.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid must manage an ethical conflict in CAD/CAM. What is the right attitude?
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'Deontology is the essential guide for resolving ethical conflicts.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must write an article on the future of CAD/CAM. Which trend should be highlighted?
options: Technological innovation in service to the patient
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'The future of CAD/CAM is based on technological innovation in service to the patient.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid must create a quality label for practices in CAD/CAM. What are the main criteria?
options: Safety, training and quality of restorations
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'Safety, training and quality of restorations are the fundamental criteria for a quality label.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should she leave?
options: The profession needs passionate and visionary people
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'The profession needs passionate people to continue evolving.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid must create a scholarship for dental students interested in CAD/CAM. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'Encouraging excellence in CAD/CAM is an investment for the future.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must pass on her knowledge in CAD/CAM. What is the most effective method?
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'Personalized mentoring and practical cases are the most effective methods for passing on knowledge.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid must create a peer network for young dentists in CAD/CAM. What is the objective?
options: Foster mutual support and experience sharing
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'Mutual support and sharing are essential for young dentists in CAD/CAM.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must write a conclusion to her work on CAD/CAM. What is the final sentence?
options: CAD/CAM is a revolution in service to the patient
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'CAD/CAM is a revolution in service to the patient, improving the precision and quality of care.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Values and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'Values and example are the most beautiful legacy one can leave.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must train future mentors in CAD/CAM. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of accompaniment and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income

questions.question: Dr Rachid must write a letter to future dentists about CAD/CAM. What message should he convey?
options: CAD/CAM is a tool that deserves to be mastered
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'CAD/CAM is a powerful tool that deserves to be mastered to improve care.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must create a prize for innovative young dentists in CAD/CAM. What is the goal?
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'Innovation and creativity are the drivers of evolution in CAD/CAM.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid, after a life dedicated to CAD/CAM, receives a national tribute. Dr Samia is by his side. What is Dr Rachid's message to young dentists?
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid concludes: 'CAD/CAM needs passion and dedication to continue evolving and improving care.'
